Mission Local reported that the State Bar had directed San Francisco DA Brooke Jenkins to participate in an ethics diversion program over her improper access to and sharing of a confidential rap sheet. The column described the decision as ironic because Jenkins had moved away from diversion programs as DA, and argued that her explanation for accessing and emailing the record appeared to be a tacit admission of breaking the law.
